detail.title: ICE-C200 V2 CPU Air Cooler
detail.overview: Upgrade your PC’s thermal management with theAnt Esports ICE-C200 V2. Designed for reliable performance and broad compatibility, this tower-style air cooler is the perfect solution for maintaining optimal temperatures for your processor.
features: Upgrade your PC’s thermal management with theAnt Esports ICE-C200 V2. Designed for reliable performance and broad compatibility, this tower-style air cooler is the perfect solution for maintaining optimal temperatures for your processor.

Universal Compatibility:Whether you are running the latest AMD or Intel platform, the ICE-C200 V2 has you covered. It supports a wide range of sockets includingAMD AM5, AM4, AM3+, AM3, AM2+, FM2, FM1andIntel LGA1851, LGA1700, LGA115X, LGA1200, LGA1366, LGA775.
Efficient Cooling Design:Featuring a robust tower design equipped with2 heatpipes, this cooler ensures effective heat dissipation for your CPU.
Quiet & Powerful Fan:The included92mm fanoperates at1800 RPM, delivering48 CFM of airflowwhile maintaining a low noise profile of just26 dBAfor a distraction-free environment.
